name: supervisors
description: A pane of animated Clawds, one per agent and dressed by team, showing what each supervisor is doing and how it directs its team

autoOpen.title: Open the Supervisors pane automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the pane the first time a supervisor appears in a session. Off: open it with /supervisors.

animate.title: Animate Clawds
animate.description: Play each agent's Clawd loop. Off: every Clawd shows a still frame.
